summary: Stepstone Private Credit Fund LLC filed an 8-K reporting the August 2026 sale of 1,134,111 unregistered shares for $29.5 million under its continuous private offering, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. The filing also disclosed July 31, 2026 NAV per share of $26.02 and aggregate NAV of $3,021.8 million, plus ongoing offering status up to $10 billion. This is a routine periodic disclosure of unregistered securities sales and NAV, not a special situation; no extraordinary corporate action, tender, restructuring, or activist event is present.
